response.sql: SELECT e.status, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS member_count, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(c) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a2.link_to_member) AS c FROM attendance a2 JOIN event e2 ON a2.link_to_event = e2.event_id GROUP BY e2.status)) AS proportion FROM attendance a JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.status
